replies.author: Porkyyy
replies.body:
After reviewing your report, we have decided that this player was not hacking for the following reasons:

This player was most likely using kit Poseidon. I have talked with one of the Map Developers and he stated that kit Poseidon has infinite fire resistance.
Also, this player had a fishing rod in his inventory, and kit Poseidon includes a fishing rod.

Therefore, I am going to deny this report, as this player was most likely not hacking.
However, if you can gather up more evidence to support your claim, you may fill out another player report.

Thank you for your concern!

Regards,
MLGPorky, Avicus Network Moderator.
